description: Structured response for authentication token refresh, containing the new access token and refresh token

success.description: Indicates if the token refresh was successful

data.description: Object containing the new access token and refresh token

accessToken.description: The newly issued access token for authentication

refreshToken.description: A 64-character hexadecimal refresh token (lowercase or uppercase 0-9, a-f)

expiresInSeconds.description: The number of seconds until the access token expires
